[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is generally recommended to meditate before a meal, or at least an hour after eating, due to the distracting and uncomfortable nature of the digestive process during meditation.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for improving mindfulness during meditation include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Focus on your breath: Pay attention to each inhale and exhale.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Use a mantra: Repeat a word or phrase to improve focus.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Practice regularly: Make meditation a daily habit, even for a few minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Avoid distractions: Choose a quiet place and turn off distracting devices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Don't judge yourself: Gently bring your attention back when your mind wanders without self-judgment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mindfulness is a skill that takes time and practice to develop; immediate results should not be expected.
